channel.title: Krishant Timilsina — Writing
channel.description: Essays and notes on software systems by Krishant Timilsina.

item.title: Building the Factory, Not the Feature: How I Work with AI Agents
item.description: Coding agents made writing code cheap. The work moved to everything around it: written-down context, session logs, tests that replace manual checks, and guardrails that live in config instead of vigilance.

item.title: The Myth of Simplicity in Software Systems
item.description: Software systems rarely stay simple—over time, growing scale, requirements, and organizations inevitably transform initial simplicity into managed complexity.

item.title: When the System Fights Back: A Journey into Chaos Engineering
item.description: How controlled failure testing exposed retry storms, strengthened resilience, and changed the team's engineering culture.

item.title: Introduction to Golang
item.description: A day-one Go learning log covering packages, variables, loops, functions, structs, pointers, and interfaces.
